title: Water Pollution Urgent
description: Use this service request to report dumping of any materials on City or vacant property that is exposed to rain or that can enter into a creek, river or lake. Use this service request if an emergency or urgent response is needed. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone for information about urgently reporting water pollution.
actions.why: For urgent dumping of material on City or vacant property where rain may carry it into a creek, river, or lake. The "Water Pollution Urgent" page has no online request button and instructs people to call 311 for more information.
